events.event: MSCI is due to announce its November 2026 index review around 05:00 WIB on 12 November, with MTEL, WIFI and RAJA at risk of Small Cap deletion and BRMS at risk of moving from Standard to Small Cap.
events.key_numbers: Announcement ~05:00 WIB Thu 12 Nov · effective after close Mon 30 Nov (from 1 Dec) · MTEL est. free-float mcap ~US$177 jt (9 Nov) · WIFI ~US$99 jt · RAJA ~US$108 jt vs retention threshold ~US$173 jt · BRMS retention price ~Rp440 · MSCI freeze on new IMI additions/upgrades continues
events.why_it_matters: The first MSCI verdict since the Standalone-downgrade proposal moves which Indonesian stocks index funds must sell.
events.spreading_evidence: CNBC Indonesia, Bisnis, Kontan, Periskop all running pre-announcement pieces

events.event: BEI widened the high shareholder concentration (HSC) list from 83 to 383 stocks by dropping the Rp5 trillion market-cap screen and the price-impact test, and will exclude them from IHSG calculation from Friday 13 November.
events.key_numbers: 300 stocks added -> 383 total · ~6.16% of IHSG market cap · HSC rule: 10 or fewer holders own >=92.5% · effective Fri 13 Nov 2026 · full list due 12 Nov
events.why_it_matters: IHSG will be calculated without hundreds of thinly-held stocks, so the headline index changes meaning for retail investors.

events.event: IHSG closed down 0.21% at 5,115.04 on 11 November ahead of the MSCI announcement, after hitting an intraday low of 5,086.02.
events.key_numbers: Close 5,115.04 (-10.69 pts, -0.21%) · open 5,139.09 · intraday range 5,086.02-5,144.79 · volume 310.74 jt lot · value Rp7.87 T · foreign net sell ~Rp20.7 M (Kontan) · basic materials -2.09% · 10 Nov close 5,125.73
events.why_it_matters: IHSG sits just above 5,100 the day before MSCI's call.

events.event: The rupiah closed weaker at Rp18,149 per USD on 11 November, down 0.48% from Rp18,062, a day before MSCI's announcement and the 17-18 November BI meeting.
events.key_numbers: Close Rp18,149 (Kontan, spot) · prior close Rp18,062 · -0.48% · other quotes Rp18,114 (Media Indonesia/Suara) · 2026 weakest close remains 8 Jun Rp18,170 (Bisnis)/Rp18,188 (Kontan) · BI-Rate 5.75% · Oct inflation 3.23% y/y
events.why_it_matters: A rupiah near Rp18,150 raises costs of imports, travel and USD debt; vendor closes differ by tens of rupiah.
events.spreading_evidence: detikFinance headline 'dolar naik lagi ke Rp18.100'

events.event: Garuda Indonesia (GIAA) filed a third rights issue of up to 248.7 billion new shares, in which Danantara Asset Management would pay in kind with its 65.77% stake in GMFI.
events.key_numbers: Up to 248,705,613,200 new Series E shares · up to Rp6.22 T headline (note: at Rp58-68 per share implies ~Rp14.4-16.9 T, unreconciled in source) · dilution up to 37.92% · exercise price Rp58-68 · DAM holds 91.11% · GMFI 82.10 miliar Series B shares (65.77%) · record date 23 Dec 2026 · rights trading 29 Dec-7 Jan 2027
events.why_it_matters: Shows how Danantara is recapitalising a state airline, and small GIAA holders face heavy dilution.

events.event: Indonesia's government priced its second Panda Bond, CNY10 billion in three tenors, drawing CNY17.26 billion in orders to help fund the 2026 APBN.
events.key_numbers: CNY10 miliar (~Rp27.15 T) · orders CNY17.26 miliar (~Rp46.87 T), 1.726x · 3y 1.96% (CNY5.7 mlr) · 5y 2.15% (CNY3.7 mlr) · 7y 2.50% (CNY600 jt) · priced 10 Nov, settlement 17 Nov · AAA (Stable) China Lianhe
events.why_it_matters: Indonesia borrows in yuan at about 2% while the rupiah weakens.

events.event: BPH Migas raised the 2026 subsidised Solar quota to 20.27 million kilolitres (about +7.8%) while keeping the Pertalite allocation at 29.26 million kilolitres.
events.key_numbers: Solar 20.27 jt KL (+7.8%) · Pertalite 29.26 jt KL unchanged · 8 provinces reportedly over their Pertalite allocation · Pertalite Rp10,000/l
events.why_it_matters: A fixed Pertalite quota raises the question of what happens in December if it runs out.

events.event: Fed Governor Christopher Waller said a 50 bps hike in December should be considered if core inflation stays high, while markets still price a 25 bps move.
events.key_numbers: Dec Fed move priced ~25 bps (near fully) · 50 bps odds ~10% (from ~15%) · US Oct CPI +0.4% m/m (0.3% consensus) · BOJ rate 1.25%
events.why_it_matters: A Fed hike keeps pressure on the rupiah and on BI's 17-18 Nov decision.

events.event: Boeing will lay off about 2,500 employees, roughly 5% of its Commercial Airplanes division, with notices starting in December.
events.key_numbers: ~2,500 jobs · ~5% of ~50,000 BCA staff · BCA Q3 2026 loss US$697 jt · BCA 44% of Boeing revenue · notices from Dec
events.why_it_matters: Limited direct Indonesia effect, but Garuda and Lion Air depend on Boeing deliveries.

events.event: BNI will begin closing its BNI Mobile Banking app on 30 November 2026, with customer access ending on 21 December 2026, and is moving customers to wondr by BNI.
events.key_numbers: Start 30 Nov 2026 · full end 21 Dec 2026 · replacement app wondr by BNI · BNI says no material impact
events.why_it_matters: Millions of BNI customers must migrate apps before 21 December or lose mobile access.
